data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

.claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug should either successfully create a ticket and return a valid ID, or fail with a non-zero exit code and error message.

#### Actual Behavior

First invocation returned ticket ID add0-4174 on stdout (exit code 0). However, .claude/scripts/dso ticket show add0-4174 returned: Error: ticket "add0-4174" has no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event. The ticket was not actually persisted. A second invocation with identical content succeeded (fbb2-898f-2259-416b).

### 3. Action History

1. Ran .claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug with a long title + heredoc description
2. Script returned add0-4174 on stdout, empty stderr, exit 0
3. Ran .claude/scripts/dso ticket show add0-4174 -> error
4. Ran .claude/scripts/dso ticket exists add0-4174 -> error (exit 1)
5. Retried same create command -> succeeded with fbb2-898f-2259-416b

### 4. Possible Contributing Factors

The description used shell interpolation inside the heredoc ($(git rev-parse HEAD)). The heredoc delimiter was DESC not 'DESC', allowing shell expansion. This may have caused unexpected behavior in the ticket creation pipeline. However, the second invocation used the same pattern and succeeded.
data.title: [ticket-create]: First ticket create invocation returned add0-4174 but ticket not found by ticket show -> silent creation failure
